name: Kwiniaska (Vermont ridge, Champlain Valley, first colour)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Kwiniaska Golf Club, Shelburne, Vermont (course chat 2026-10-30, from the VCGI leaf-off and NAIP leaf-on photos): cool Kentucky-bluegrass greens on the fairways and greens; a mown band of rough (G3-G5) then rough with a golden cast of the fescue and goldenrod the photos show beside the holes (F0-F2); a mossy, leaf-littered floor under the hardwood woods (G0-G2); Champlain Valley hay fields beyond the boundary (L0-L2); creamy-white bunker sand; dark slate-blue ponds; grey Vermont granite and slate in the paths and roofs. Trees in assets-src/trees_kwiniaska.py: sugar maple, paper birch, ash and oak mostly still green, a few maples turning (flame orange) or gone scarlet, white pine and hemlock. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
